Theorem
[Bounds for the potential gradient (Theorem 27.4)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0028 ↗ thm:chow-iv-scalar-curvature-lower-bound 1. ch27:27.4\group Potential estimates

For a complete normalized GRS and any base point $\widetilde O$:

  1. a steady soliton satisfies $| abla f|\le 1$;

  2. a shrinker has $f\ge 0$ and $| abla f|(x)\le \sqrt{f(x)}\le \sqrt{f(\widetilde O)}+d(x,\widetilde O)/2$;

  3. an expander has $f\le n/2$ and $| abla f|(x)\le \sqrt{n/2-f(x)}\le d(x,\widetilde O)/2+\sqrt{n/2-f(\widetilde O)}$.
